name: np_engine
character: A V8 in a car the listener sits in: a firing-frequency pulse train through the body, its pitch following the rpm through four gears, with the road and the spray behind it and the clunk of each shift; it dives in the slow motion and stops dead at the cut.
note: f0 is the firing frequency rpm x 8 / 120 (53.3 Hz at 800 rpm idle); the pitch curve is rpm / idle rpm through the gears of the waypoints in make_presets_sound.py, the road speed is 2 pi r rpm / (60 G) with G the box ratio times a 3.7 final drive and r = 0.33 m, and the slow motion drops the pitch an octave until the snap. ESTIMATE: gear ratios, final drive, tyre radius, the body formants and every level are starting values; no recording of an engine was measured
